knowledge:
- key_parameters: spectraPaths=Character vector of paths to NetCDF, mzML, mzXML, or mzData files ;; targetFeatTable=Data frame defining targeted features with columns: cpdID, cpdName, rtMin, rt, rtMax, mzMin, mz, mzMax ;; curveModel=Peak-shape model to fit to each EIC; options are 'skewedGaussian' (default) or 'emgGaussian' ;; ncores=Number of CPU cores to use for parallel processing (set to 0 for serial execution) ;; useUROI=Logical indicating whether to use updated Regions Of Interest (uROI) instead of reference ROI ;; useFIR=Logical indicating whether to use Fallback Integration Regions (FIR) when no peak is found ;; peakStatistic=Logical; if TRUE, calculates additional peak statistics (ppm_error, rt_dev_sec, tailing factor, asymmetry factor)
- alternatives: peakPantheR_start_GUI(browser = TRUE)=Graphical user interface, preferred for understanding the methodology, selecting parameters on a subset of samples, or visually exploring results before running command-line scripts on large datasets
- when_to_use: Use when you have a predefined list of targeted compounds/features (with expected retention time and m/z windows) and want to automatically detect, fit, and integrate them across multiple mass spectrometry files (e.g., LC-MS metabolomics or lipidomics runs).
- pitfalls: Polarity and acquisition time cannot be extracted from NetCDF files (only mzML supports acquisition time extraction, and polarity must be set manually for NetCDF) ;; If rtMin/rtMax are outside of the ROI, datapoints cannot be used for mzMin/mzMax calculation, resulting in approximate mz values ;; polynomialOrder in retention time correction will fail or throw a warning if it is larger than or equal to the number of reference compounds passed

workflows.name: parallel_annotation
workflows.intent: Detect and integrate multiple targeted features across multiple MS files in parallel, optimize parameters using diagnostic plots, and export final results.
input: input_spectraPaths (raw MS spectra files in NetCDF/mzML/mzXML/mzData format)
input_targetFeatTable (data frame of targeted features with expected RT and m/z windows)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize annotation object with peakPantheRAnnotation ;; 2. Run initial parallel annotation with peakPantheR_parallelAnnotation ;; 3. Establish updated ROI (uROI) and fallback integration regions (FIR) using annotationParamsDiagnostic ;; 4. Save diagnostic parameters and plots to disk using outputAnnotationDiagnostic ;; 5. Load updated parameters from CSV using peakPantheR_loadAnnotationParamsCSV ;; 6. Reset annotation with new samples and enable uROI/FIR using resetAnnotation ;; 7. Run final parallel annotation with peakPantheR_parallelAnnotation ;; 8. Extract results using peakTables or annotationTable and export to disk using outputAnnotationResult
workflows.code:
library(faahKO)
input_spectraPaths <- c(system.file('cdf/KO/ko15.CDF', package = "faahKO"), system.file('cdf/KO/ko16.CDF', package = "faahKO"), system.file('cdf/KO/ko18.CDF', package = "faahKO"))
input_targetFeatTable <- data.frame(matrix(vector(), 2, 8, dimnames=list(c(), c("cpdID", "cpdName", "rtMin", "rt", "rtMax", "mzMin", "mz", "mzMax"))), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
input_targetFeatTable[1,] <- c("ID-1", "Cpd 1", 3310., 3344.888, 3390., 522.194778, 522.2, 522.205222)
input_targetFeatTable[2,] <- c("ID-2", "Cpd 2", 3280., 3385.577, 3440., 496.195038, 496.2, 496.204962)
input_targetFeatTable[,3:8] <- sapply(input_targetFeatTable[,3:8], as.numeric)
input_spectraMetadata <- data.frame(matrix(c("sample type 1", "sample type 2", "sample type 1"), 3, 1, dimnames=list(c(),c("sampleType"))), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
library(peakPantheR)
init_annotation <- peakPantheRAnnotation(spectraPaths = input_spectraPaths, targetFeatTable = input_targetFeatTable, spectraMetadata = input_spectraMetadata)
annotation_result <- peakPantheR_parallelAnnotation(init_annotation, ncores=0, curveModel='skewedGaussian', verbose=TRUE)
data_annotation <- annotation_result$annotation
updated_annotation <- annotationParamsDiagnostic(data_annotation, verbose=TRUE)
uniq_sType <- sort(unique(spectraMetadata(updated_annotation)$sampleType), na.last=TRUE)
col_sType <- unname( setNames(c('blue', 'red'), c(uniq_sType))[spectraMetadata(updated_annotation)$sampleType] )
output_folder <- tempdir()
outputAnnotationDiagnostic(updated_annotation, saveFolder=output_folder, savePlots=TRUE, sampleColour=col_sType, verbose=TRUE, ncores=2)
update_csv_path <- './1-fitParams_example_UI.csv'
new_annotation <- peakPantheR_loadAnnotationParamsCSV(update_csv_path)
new_annotation <- resetFIR(new_annotation)
new_spectraPaths <- c(system.file('cdf/KO/ko15.CDF', package = "faahKO"), system.file('cdf/WT/wt15.CDF', package = "faahKO"), system.file('cdf/KO/ko16.CDF', package = "faahKO"), system.file('cdf/WT/wt16.CDF', package = "faahKO"), system.file('cdf/KO/ko18.CDF', package = "faahKO"), system.file('cdf/WT/wt18.CDF', package = "faahKO"))
new_spectraMetadata <- data.frame(matrix(c("KO", "WT", "KO", "WT", "KO", "WT"), 6, 1, dimnames=list(c(), c("Group"))), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
new_annotation <- resetAnnotation(new_annotation, spectraPaths=new_spectraPaths, spectraMetadata=new_spectraMetadata, useUROI=TRUE, useFIR=TRUE)
new_annotation_result <- peakPantheR_parallelAnnotation(new_annotation, ncores=0, verbose=FALSE)
final_annotation <- new_annotation_result$annotation
uniq_group <- sort(unique(spectraMetadata(final_annotation)$Group),na.last=TRUE)
col_group <- unname( setNames(c('blue', 'red'), c(uniq_sType))[spectraMetadata(final_annotation)$Group] )
final_output_folder <- tempdir()
outputAnnotationDiagnostic(final_annotation, saveFolder=final_output_folder, savePlots=TRUE, sampleColour=col_group, verbose=TRUE)
peakTables(final_annotation)[[1]]
annotationTable(final_annotation, column='peakArea')
outputAnnotationResult(final_annotation, saveFolder=final_output_folder, annotationName='ProjectName', verbose=TRUE)

workflows.name: real_time_annotation
workflows.intent: Detect and integrate multiple targeted features in a single MS file in real-time (e.g., immediately after acquisition).
input: input_spectraPath (a single raw MS spectra file in NetCDF/mzML/mzXML/mzData format)
input_targetFeatTable (data frame of targeted features with expected RT and m/z windows)
workflows.stages: 1. Define targeted features in a data frame ;; 2. Run single file search using peakPantheR_singleFileSearch ;; 3. Extract TIC, acquisition time, peak table, curve fit parameters, and raw data points from the returned list
workflows.code:
library(faahKO)
input_spectraPath <- c(system.file('cdf/KO/ko15.CDF', package = "faahKO"))
input_targetFeatTable <- data.frame(matrix(vector(), 2, 8, dimnames=list(c(), c("cpdID", "cpdName", "rtMin", "rt", "rtMax", "mzMin", "mz", "mzMax"))), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
input_targetFeatTable[1,] <- c("ID-1", "Cpd 1", 3310., 3344.888, 3390., 522.194778, 522.2, 522.205222)
input_targetFeatTable[2,] <- c("ID-2", "Cpd 2", 3280., 3385.577, 3440., 496.195038, 496.2, 496.204962)
input_targetFeatTable[,c(3:8)] <- sapply(input_targetFeatTable[,c(3:8)], as.numeric)
library(peakPantheR)
annotation <- peakPantheR_singleFileSearch( singleSpectraDataPath = input_spectraPath, targetFeatTable = input_targetFeatTable, peakStatistic = TRUE, curveModel = 'skewedGaussian', verbose = TRUE)
annotation$TIC
annotation$acquTime
annotation$peakTable
annotation$curveFit
annotation$ROIsDataPoint
